ov: الدعوة (الإنجليزية: The Invite) هو فلم كوميدي أمريكي صدر عام 2026، أخرجته أوليفيا وايلد عن سيناريو كتبه ويل ماكورماك ورشيدة جونز. وهو إعادة إنتاج باللغة الإنجليزية للفلم الإسباني الجيران في الأعلى الصادر عام 2020 للمخرج سيسك غاي. يشارك في بطولة الفلم كلٌّ من سيث روغن، ووايلد، وبينيلوبي كروز، وإدوارد نورتون. عُرض الفلم لأول مرة في مسرح إكليس ضمن فعاليات مهرجان صاندانس السينمائي 2026 في 24 يناير، وحظي بإشادة نقدية. ثم طُرح في عرض محدود في الولايات المتحدة في 26 يونيو، قبل أن يُطرح في عدد أكبر من دور العرض في 10 يوليو، من توزيع إيه 24. وحقق 42.2 مليون دولار في جميع أنحاء العالم.
plotEn:
In San Francisco, musician Joe arrives home from his job as a band teacher at a conservatory, to discover his stay-at-home wife, Angela, has invited their upstairs neighbors, divorcée, Piña, and widower, Hawk, over for dinner at their apartment. Joe and Angela's marriage is rocky, and they bicker constantly, most recently over the loud sex sounds they often hear from upstairs. Joe plans to confront the couple, but Angela, who is desperate to impress the neighbors, demands he keep calm and quiet.
Piña and Hawk arrive at the apartment as Joe and Angela are mid-argument. Unprepared to host a dinner party, Angela makes several awkward mistakes, such as not having any wine, and not checking Piña's dietary restrictions. Meanwhile, Joe openly antagonizes the couple, but is surprised to see they are impressed by his brutally honest nature. The group eventually warm up to one another, although Joe still resents his neighbors.
Later that night, Piña and Hawk apologize for the noise they make during sex, and reveal to Joe and Angela that they participate in sex parties, which is the reason for the noise; Joe and Angela are titillated by this discovery, but Joe grows angry again when he learns Hawk has seen Angela naked through a window. Breaking the tension, Hawk admits that he and Piña came to the dinner party hoping to invite Joe and Angela to have group sex with them. Joe and Angela are eager, but Piña, who is a psychotherapist and sexologist, is unsure after seeing the couple fight
